component.name: Vellum
component.summary: Read and edit Markdown in eight typographic styles

description.p: Vellum shows a Markdown document as it would be published, while it is still the file you are editing. There is one view, not two: the syntax characters are hidden until the cursor reaches them, so the document reads as prose and stays editable in the same breath.

ul.li: Eight reading styles — Adwaita, Newsprint, Academic, Sepia, Book, Terminal, Contrast and Typewriter — each a complete typographic system in light and dark
A live mode that reveals only the Markdown under the cursor, a source mode that shows all of it, and a reading mode that shows none
A heading outline that follows you down the page
Formatting from the right-click menu or the keyboard, written as Markdown into the file
Word count and reading time as you write

description.p: Your document stays a plain Markdown file throughout. Nothing is stored beside it, and nothing is added to it that another editor would not understand.
